evidence.quote: This is Anders Forslund.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

entities.name: Hart Aerospace
entities.how_described: 本集主角:洛杉矶一个 40 人团队,造混合动力电动飞机以降低航空旅行成本,刚完成世界最大电动飞机的首飞(翼展 100 英尺、25,000 磅)。(转写稿中亦写作 Hart Airspace,为同一家公司)

evidence.quote: I visited Hart Aerospace's headquarters in LA to find out.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: How would you describe Hart Aerospace in two sentences?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

entities.name: 电动马达 (electric motor)
entities.how_described: 本集把它说成:Hart 飞机的核心,只有一个运动部件、没有燃烧和流体,磨损基本为零、可便宜得多地生产,滑行时以十分之一转速运转几乎静音

evidence.quote: An electric motor has essentially only one moving part, no combustion, and doesn't really wear out.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: We just brought them over, showed them the electric motor we built that was the size of the jet engines we tried to replace.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_03

entities.name: 喷气发动机 (jet engine)
entities.how_described: 本集把它说成:有数千个部件、烧着足以熔化金属的燃油;为 30 座和 70 座飞机制造成本相同、磨损与航程无关,把行业推向大飞机长航线,把短途区域飞行服务得很糟糕

evidence.quote: Hart's plane swapped the jet engine for electric motors.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: A jet engine has thousands of parts and birds' fuel hot enough to melt metal.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: When you're taxiing with a jet engine, the rest of it is, by definition, is noise.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_03

evidence.quote: To understand why this is such a big deal, let's look at what's broken about the jet engine, especially when it comes to short flights.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: It's as complex to build a jet engine for a 30-seater as it is for a 70-seater, so it costs the same.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_03

evidence.quote: Like the 400 kilowatt motor, which was like the size of a small jet engine, that in turn attracted actual, you know, pre-orders and then they came from United and then that attracted more capital and then we started building and now we're building towards the plane.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_03

entities.name: 混合动力 (hybrid)
entities.how_described: 本集把它说成:纯电池飞机要把三分之二电池留给备降储备这一法规难题的答案——加一个约 20% 前期成本的备用涡桨发动机,把航程从纯电动 125 英里扩展到 500 英里,且已处于显著的负绿色溢价

evidence.quote: Its successor, the ES-30, will fly up to 125 miles on battery alone, up to 500 miles as a hybrid, and recharge in about 30 minutes.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: We build hybrid electric aircraft, but our mission is to reduce the cost of air travel, and we're building the technology to support that.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: Their answer is a hybrid engine.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: You can fly up to 125 miles all electrically, and then you fly up to 500 miles with a hybrid system operational range.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_03

evidence.quote: The great thing about using hybrid electric is that it's already now at a significant negative green premium.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_03

entities.name: SpaceX
entities.how_described: 本集把它说成:Anders 借鉴其风险哲学的对象——传统航空航天压低出事概率,而 SpaceX 的思路是把做错的影响降到最低,从而选择更便宜、更易迭代的流程;洛杉矶新航天生态也源自它

evidence.quote: That call comes out of the philosophy that Anders borrowed from SpaceX, about how you should treat risk.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: Somebody doing what SpaceX did with rockets on airplanes just makes sense.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_03

evidence.quote: You have the new space ecosystem that's kind of coming from SpaceX.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_03

entities.name: 电池 (battery)
entities.how_described: 本集把它说成:飞机的动力来源是八个电池组(约四辆特斯拉的电池量);电池实验室里比较中美韩厂商电芯,桌上最高约 370 瓦时/公斤,几个月内将有 400 水平的产品

evidence.quote: Its successor, the ES-30, will fly up to 125 miles on battery alone, up to 500 miles as a hybrid, and recharge in about 30 minutes.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: And the power source is eight battery packs laid across the floor of the plane.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: And the heart of the operation is the battery lab, where the team is choosing to sell for the next aircraft.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: This is the battery cell lab where we are trying to determine what our cell is going to be.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: The hardest problem had nothing to do with the motor or the battery.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_03

evidence.quote: So if you build a battery electric aircraft, you kind of have to carry two-thirds of your battery needs to be for reserves.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_03

entities.name: United
entities.how_described: 本集把它说成:从垃圾邮件文件夹里捞出来的大客户——发到 info 邮箱的主动来信被 Clara 识别,看了 400 千瓦电机后基本立刻下了预订单

evidence.quote: Like the 400 kilowatt motor, which was like the size of a small jet engine, that in turn attracted actual, you know, pre-orders and then they came from United and then that attracted more capital and then we started building and now we're building towards the plane.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_03

evidence.quote: United Airlines came through an inbound email through our info email.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_03

entities.name: Boeing and Airbus
entities.how_described: 本集把它说成:Hart 以小团队在挑战这两家巨头都未能做到的事(造出全新设计客机);737 和 A320 那样的窄体机是更大的后续市场

evidence.quote: With a relatively small team, they're going after something that Boeing and Airbus have not been able to pull off.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02
